Director, Office of Tec Director, Office of Technical Certification and Research

     Issuance Date:         December 29, 2014

             Purpose:       This bulletin clarifies requirements for acceptable equipment in accordance with section BC
                            3001.9.

            Related              AC 28-113.2.3                1RCNY 101-07
        Code/Zoning              BC 3001.9
         Section(s):

             Related             BB 2012-001
           Buildings
          Bulletin(s):

          Subject(s):       Elevator, equipment, approval


   Section BC 3001.9 requires all equipment prescribed in ASME A17.1, section 8.3 to be approved by the
   commissioner. This bulletin clarifies that equipment used in accordance with section AC 28-113.2 and ASME
   A17.1, section 8.3 as prescribed shall be deemed acceptable by the commissioner.

   Acceptable equipment shall be listed by an approved agency in accordance with section AC 28-113.2.3, ASME A17.1
   section 8.3.1, and 1 RCNY 101-07.
